description: The closed vocabulary a capability's data_domain must use. A subject appears once, under one estate domain, with every spelling it has been written as. An open vocabulary produced 84 values for 158 annotations, including three spellings of RGB-D and two of gaussian-splat; a coordination layer whose systems name the same subject differently cannot answer a question that spans them.
